title: Reliquary selective-reuse clean rebuild capability plan
principle: Build required externally observable capabilities directly in approved target architecture. Existing source is optional reference material, not mandatory transfer inventory.
reuse_rule: For each capability evaluate: reuse unchanged / adapt / reimplement / omit. Only retain code when it contributes to the new design and passes behavioral acceptance.
slice_rule: Execute the existing capability increments. Split only a particular increment if its concrete interface/tests demand it; no speculative advance decomposition or one task per old file or function.
baseline_rule: Pinned reference remains untouched. The rebuilt workspace stays recoverable through verified commits; green workspace tests alone do not imply integration gate acceptance.
format_rule: Rebuilt normal runtime supports REL 2.1 only; 2.0-to-2.1 conversion is an isolated data task after full rebuilt product acceptance.
completion_rule: Accept a capability only after its behavior, privacy, provenance, reopen, negative cases and prerequisite gates pass. The rebuilt python scripts/check_architecture.py and relevant Cargo tests must pass. No legacy internal function-for-function replacement is required.

increments.title: Freeze reference and set up independent source baseline
increments.deliverable: A clean detached pinned reference worktree, one compact source/dirty-state evidence note, reserved isolated rebuild path; no replacement code created
increments.acceptance: Complete F01.1–F01.7: source/dirty SHA and patch custody, safe detached reference checkout at exact pinned commit, separate build-output path, real or explicitly blocked smoke test, original tree unchanged; F04 alone creates the empty rebuild tree.

increments.acceptance: Capture golden ID inputs/outputs; independently verify the six-file corpus on copies OR record exact FRS07 blocker. A failed corpus proof blocks only later conversion, not construction of unrelated new capabilities.
increments.corpus_status: historical FRS07 implementation reopened all six copies and matched pinned heads; pinned F01 reference still rejects three REL files; full historical fingerprint and conversion remain unverified
